name: Sensitive Toothpaste — Soothing Relief
tagline: Calm-formula relief for sensitive teeth and gums.
shortDescription: Clinically aligned potassium nitrate paste that soothes nerve sensitivity from the first brush.
description: Built for teeth that flinch at cold, hot, or sweet. Our soothing formula combines potassium nitrate — the active dentists most frequently recommend for sensitivity — with a gentle, low-RDA base that won't aggravate exposed dentin. Calming and effective from day one, with measurable relief in two weeks.
howToUse: Use morning and night for the first two weeks for fastest relief.
Apply a pea-sized amount to a soft-bristled brush.
Brush gently for two full minutes.
Spit, don't rinse. Continue daily for ongoing protection.
highlights: Soothes within 14 days of daily use
